title: Kidney Characterization Pipeline for Tissue Analysis
author: Elizabeth Neumann
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfskjncw
materials: Stabilize and freeze tissues. Freezing Tissue: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6wghfbw
RNA Assessment from tissue. RNA extraction: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.86nhzde

steps.title: Perform Initial Rapid Pathology Assessment
steps.instruction: Conduct an initial rapid pathology assessment of the kidney tissue staining.

steps.title: Cryosection Tissues
steps.instruction: Cryosection tissues into micrometer thick sections using one of two methods based on downstream analysis.

substeps.instruction: Thaw mount sections onto indium tin-oxide and positively charged glass slides for further imaging/staining.
Collect several tissue sections within a microcentrifuge tube for proteomics analysis.

steps.title: Perform Autofluorescence Microscopy
steps.instruction: Perform autofluorescence microscopy on all tissue sections prior to IMS or MxIF analysis.

steps.title: Apply MALDI Matrix
steps.instruction: Coat the tissue sections with MALDI matrix for IMS analysis.

steps.title: Perform High Resolution IMS Analysis
steps.instruction: Conduct high resolution IMS analysis of the matrix-coated tissue sections.

steps.title: Visualize Laser Ablation Spots
steps.instruction: Perform fluorescence microscopy to visualize the laser ablation spots following IMS.

steps.title: Annotate Lipids from IMS Data
steps.instruction: Calibrate and annotate lipids from the IMS data.

steps.title: Perform PAS Staining
steps.instruction: Remove the MALDI matrix and perform PAS staining.

steps.title: Perform Multiplex Immunofluorescence (MxIF)
steps.instruction: Alternatively, perform MxIF after the cryosectioning step.

steps.title: Register Autofluorescence Images
steps.instruction: Register autofluorescence images from both IMS and MxIF sections to allow for direct correlation of the two orthogonal approaches.

steps.title: Process MALDI IMS Data
steps.instruction: Perform data processing of the MALDI imaging mass spectrometry data.

steps.title: Perform LC-based Proteomics
steps.instruction: Perform LC-based proteomics on adjacent tissue sections.
